Class MacroRegistry

java.lang.Object
commands.macro.MacroRegistry
public class MacroRegistry extends Object
Registry for macro command definitions loaded from configuration. Handles creation of MacroCommand instances from config definitions. Integrates with CommandRegistry to register macros as first-class commands.
